_comment: Tunable scam/fraud red-flag reference for risk_signals.py. This is GENERIC public knowledge (no case data) — safe to commit. Edit freely as you learn; it is a STARTER set, not exhaustive or authoritative. Always verify before asserting BPH in a client-facing product.

nrd._comment: Newly-registered-domain age tiers, in days since WHOIS creation. Scam infra is overwhelmingly young; age is a strong prior, never proof alone.

bph._comment: Bulletproof / abuse-tolerant hosting indicators. Match is a LEAD, not attribution. ASN classification needs an ASN lookup (not yet wired) — provider/registrar/NS substring matching works on data we already capture. TUNE: verify each entry is still BPH before relying on it.
abuse_tolerant_registrars: _comment: registrars over-represented in bulk scam registration. Presence != BPH, but combined with NRD + money-ask it raises the score.

money_trail._comment: Money-trail indicators — how the operator gets PAID or CONTACTED to close the fraud. Per the analyst: the single most crucial category for victim-loss cases and takedown/LE referral. Any crypto-payment-ask on a young unbranded site is a strong scam signal.
money_trail.high_signal_combo: young domain (NRD) + crypto wallet present + off-platform contact handle (telegram/whatsapp) = classic payment-funnel; escalate.
trace_priority: reused crypto wallet across sites (attribution-grade — same payee)
payment processor / merchant IDs (Stripe, PayPal, local gateways)
IBAN / SWIFT / bank handles in forms or chat
